# AI Crypto Wallet

> AI Crypto Wallet (AI 炒币助手) is a self-custodial cryptocurrency wallet for Android with an on-device AI self-trading agent. Private keys stay on your device and are never exposed to the AI.

## What this is

AI Crypto Wallet is a non-custodial crypto wallet with a built-in AI trading agent that runs entirely on-device. The AI reads market data (RSI, MACD, moving averages, Bollinger Bands), monitors open positions, and can execute stop-loss / take-profit trades within a hard safety gate. Private keys are generated and stored locally and are never transmitted or shown to the AI.

## Key facts

- Type: Self-custodial (non-custodial) crypto wallet for Android
- Core feature: On-device AI self-trading agent
- Chains supported: BNB, ETH, MATIC, AVAX, FTM, ARB, OP, BASE, SOL, TRX (10 chains)
- Security: Three defense lines (TradeAuthManager, SafetyGate, RiskManager), circuit breaker, daily and per-trade limits, token whitelist, full audit logs
- Cross-chain defaults: $100 per-trade, $500 daily cap
- Platform token: R-MAB (ecosystem participant privileges)
- Languages: English, 中文, 日本語, Deutsch
- License: Business Source License 1.1 (BSL-1.1), source-available and publicly auditable (NOT OSI open source)
- License conversion: Apache 2.0 after Change Date 2031-08-06
